issue.title: %c and bob attachments import copy files vault-sync will refuse (≥95 MiB) or git ignores (.heic, .zip, …)

task_type_fields.impact: Trigger 1 stops all vault git sync on the capturing host (athena/apollo/Mac) until someone notices and removes the file by hand. Trigger 2 produces vault notes whose embeds and links work only on one host, with no warning. Both are reachable today from one `%c` capture in Bob Mac Capture.
task_type_fields.repro:
**Repro (scratch vault, dry run, nothing written):**

```bash
T=$(mktemp -d); printf -- '---\ntype: "[[area]]"\nparent: "[[area]]"\n---\n# Mac Inbox\n\n## Tasks\n' > $T/mac_inbox.md
S=$(mktemp -d); truncate -s 100M $S/big.mov
BOB_CLIPBOARD_CMD="echo $S/big.mov" bob capture -b $T --dry-run 'Big clip %c'
# → plans "- [[file/big.mov]]" and "would save file/big.mov" with no refusal
cd ~/bob && git check-ignore -q img/x.heic && echo IGNORED   # also avif, tif/tiff, bmp, ico, file/x.zip, file/x.docx
```

**Two gaps, one remediation site.** `plan_attachments` (`src/native/capture_clip/files.rs:126`) runs `fs::read(source)` without checking size or sync-ability, and `bob attachments import` (and the Z path-bullet import) reuses it:

1. **Size.** A copied file of 95 MiB or more (`vault_sync::LARGE_FILE_LIMIT_BYTES`) makes `preflight_one_file` (`src/native/vault_sync.rs:1274`) return `CycleError::fatal`. Every later `bob vault-sync` on that host fails until someone deletes the file by hand.
2. **Ignored extensions.** `IMAGE_EXTENSIONS` copies `.heic/.avif/.tif/.tiff/.bmp/.ico` into `img/`, and the vault allowlist `.gitignore` ignores all of them. Any `file/` extension outside the allowlist (`.zip`, `.docx`, …) is ignored too. The capture succeeds, but the embed or link is broken on every other host, silently.

**Suggested fix:** check `fs::metadata(source).len()` before reading. Refuse at or above `LARGE_FILE_LIMIT_BYTES`, with a new `too_large` code for `bob attachments import`, and add a structured `attachment_large` capture warning at or above `LARGE_FILE_WARNING_BYTES` (50 MiB). When `BOB_DIR` is a git work tree, run the planned destinations through one `git check-ignore --stdin` and refuse ignored ones with an actionable message. Update `docs/capture.md` (Clipboard) and `docs/attachments.md`.

Found while researching video embeds for `%c`; that design would route `.mp4` clips through the same planner, which makes trigger 1 much more likely. Report: `research:202611/video_clip_embeds_and_z_viewer__cld.md`.

issue.creation_reason: Found while researching video embeds for %c: the shared attachment planner has no size or sync-ability check, so a single capture can wedge vault sync or create single-host embeds.
